title: Create Preindustrial
description: This pack strips down the create mod, removing post-medieval features. You can use this modpack as a base for whatever fantasy/medieval modpack you want to make.
body:
Create: Pre-industrial uses Item Obliterator to remove items from Create, specifically anything that would be out of place in a pre-industrial world. Also included in the pack are Valkyrien skies and some of its smaller addons (so that you can use physics in your medieveal builds) and Create: Horse Power, so that you can generate rotational force through mob labor.

This is meant to be used as a base in any modpack that wants the moving parts of Create without the industrial aspect, for better immersion in medieval, fantasy, or vanilla+ modpacks.
